name: Sepang International Circuit
summary: Malaysia's twin-grandstand circuit, known for heat and afternoon storms.
character: Wide, fast corners, two long straights and a hairpin at each end of the back straight. The heat is fierce, and tropical storms often arrive in the middle of the afternoon.

moments.title: Multi 21
moments.body: In 2013 Red Bull told its drivers to hold position. Sebastian Vettel ignored the order and passed Mark Webber for the win.

history.body: Stopped by a storm after 31 laps, so drivers got half points.
Back for one race, hosting the Bahrain Grand Prix.

leftCalendar: Crowds fell while hosting fees rose, and Malaysia ended its contract after 2017. Sepang returned once in 2026, standing in for Bahrain.
